world.headline: US President Trump Demands Unconditional Surrender from Iran Amid Escalating Airstrikes
world.description: US President Donald Trump declared no negotiations with Iran until its unconditional surrender, as Israel launched extensive airstrikes on Tehran and Beirut, resulting in explosions, heavy smoke, and civilian evacuations. The strikes targeted Hezbollah infrastructure and caused significant disruptions to regional energy supplies via the Strait of Hormuz.
world.context: The ongoing US-Israel-Iran conflict stems from the assassination of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in prior bombings, prompting Iranian retaliation supported by Russian intelligence. This escalation has displaced nearly 500,000 in Lebanon and raised US gas prices by 34 cents per gallon, highlighting risks to global energy markets and humanitarian crises.

timeline.label: Assassination of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
Israeli airstrikes on Tehran and Beirut

key_terms.definition: Critical maritime chokepoint for global oil transport, currently disrupted by conflict-related shipping avoidance
Lebanese militant group targeted in Israeli strikes, allied with Iran

world.headline: Ecuadorian Troops Discover 35-Meter Narco-Submersible in Nature Reserve
world.description: Ecuador's military uncovered a 35-meter-long drug-trafficking submersible laden with fuel and prepared for deployment, hidden in a protected nature reserve.
world.context: This discovery underscores the intensifying battle against narco-trafficking networks in Latin America, where submersibles are increasingly used to evade detection. It highlights Ecuador's collaboration with international partners amid rising violence linked to drug cartels.

timeline.label: Increase in narco-sub seizures reported by Ecuadorian authorities
Discovery of submersible in nature reserve

key_terms.definition: Semi-submerged vessel used by drug traffickers to transport narcotics undetected across oceans

world.headline: Emergency Calls Expose Severe Conditions at Largest US ICE Detention Facility
world.description: 911 recordings from the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement's primary detention center reveal incidents of attempted suicides, physical altercations, and untreated medical pain among detainees.
world.context: The facility, the largest operated by ICE, has faced persistent allegations of inadequate care and overcrowding. These disclosures amplify calls for oversight reforms in the US immigration detention system amid broader debates on migrant treatment.

timeline.label: Initial reports of overcrowding at ICE facilities
Release of 911 call recordings highlighting detainee crises

key_terms.definition: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, agency managing migrant detention

national.headline: Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh Advance Legislation to Restrict Social Media for Minors
national.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu announced a 90-day deadline to implement a ban on social media access for children under 13, while Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah proposed restrictions for those under 16.
national.context: These measures address rising concerns over online harms to youth, including cyberbullying and addiction, aligning with national efforts to enhance child digital safety through regulatory frameworks.

timeline.label: National consultations on child online protection initiated
State announcements on social media bans for minors

key_terms.definition: Policy framework to limit minors' exposure to harmful online content

national.headline: Jharkhand Headmaster Suspended Over Inappropriate Dance Video with Students
national.description: A school headmaster in Jharkhand was suspended, and two para-teachers placed under inquiry following a video of them dancing to explicit songs with Class 8 students at a farewell event.
national.context: The incident has sparked public outrage and renewed focus on teacher conduct and child safeguarding protocols in Indian schools, prompting swift administrative action.

timeline.label: Video surfaces on social media
Suspension and inquiry initiated

key_terms.definition: Institutional measures to protect minors from exploitation in educational settings

national.headline: Indian Railways Upgrades 42nd Vande Bharat Train to 20-Coach Capacity
national.description: Two years post-launch, the 42nd Vande Bharat express train has been enhanced to accommodate 20 coaches, improving passenger capacity on its designated route.
national.context: This upgrade supports India's rail modernization drive, aiming to boost efficiency and reduce travel times amid growing demand for high-speed connectivity.

timeline.label: Initial launch of Vande Bharat fleet
Upgrade to 20-coach configuration

key_terms.definition: Semi-high-speed train service enhancing intra-city connectivity

national.headline: Srinagar Court Rejects ED's Bid to Add Charges in JKCA Scam Case
national.description: A Srinagar court blocked the Enforcement Directorate's attempt to supplement charges in the Jammu and Kashmir Cricket Association scam, citing the CBI's prior chargesheet filing.
national.context: The ruling underscores jurisdictional boundaries between investigative agencies, potentially impacting ongoing probes into sports corruption in India.

timeline.label: Initial JKCA scam investigation begins
Court order denying ED's charge addition

key_terms.definition: Financial irregularities case involving Jammu and Kashmir Cricket Association

national.headline: Amit Shah Launches Digital Tools and Mascots for Census 2027
national.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah introduced 'Pragati' and 'Vikas' mascots alongside four digital platforms integrating satellite imagery and mobile apps for efficient Census 2027 enumeration.
national.context: These innovations aim to modernize India's decennial census process, ensuring accuracy and coverage through technology amid logistical challenges.

timeline.label: Previous census delayed due to pandemic
Launch of digital census tools

key_terms.definition: India's upcoming national population enumeration using advanced digital integration

national.headline: Lok Sabha Set to Debate Resolution for Speaker Om Birla's Removal
national.description: The Lok Sabha is slated to discuss a resolution by 118 Opposition MPs seeking the removal of Speaker Om Birla over alleged partisan conduct, with party whips issued for the session starting March 9.
national.context: This move reflects deepening parliamentary tensions between ruling and opposition benches, potentially affecting legislative proceedings and democratic norms.

timeline.label: Initial complaints on Speaker's impartiality raised
Resolution debate scheduled

key_terms.definition: Lower house of India's Parliament, site of proposed Speaker removal debate

national.headline: Haryana CM's Son Secures Third Rank in UPSC Civil Services Exam
national.description: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini's son, Akansh, achieved All India Rank 3 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination, prompting emotional celebrations.
national.context: The achievement highlights the competitive nature of India's premier civil services recruitment, inspiring youth while underscoring familial influences in public service aspirants.

timeline.label: UPSC preliminary exams conducted
Final results announced with Akansh Saini at AIR 3

key_terms.definition: Union Public Service Commission, conducts India's top civil services recruitment

national.headline: Central Administrative Tribunal Mandates IAS Officer for Kerala Excise Commissioner Role
national.description: The Central Administrative Tribunal ruled that the Kerala Excise Commissioner position must be held by an Indian Administrative Service officer, overturning prior appointments.
national.context: This decision reinforces cadre-specific eligibility for key administrative posts, aiming to maintain expertise and uniformity in state governance structures.

timeline.label: Dispute over non-IAS appointment raised
CAT ruling issued

key_terms.definition: Indian Administrative Service, elite civil service cadre for senior governance roles

national.headline: Indian Railways Achieves Near-Complete Electrification Enhancing Energy Security
national.description: A report notes that Indian Railways' 100% electrification milestone bolsters national energy resilience, particularly amid global supply disruptions.
national.context: The transition to electric traction reduces fossil fuel dependence, cutting costs and emissions while aligning with India's sustainable transport goals.

timeline.label: Electrification drive accelerated under national rail plan
Achievement of full network electrification confirmed

key_terms.definition: Conversion of rail tracks to electric power, reducing diesel usage by 100%

science.headline: Climate Change Acceleration Reaches 0.35°C Per Decade, Analysis Reveals
science.description: Fresh data indicates Earth's warming rate has nearly doubled to 0.35°C per decade over the past ten years, driven by intensified greenhouse gas emissions.
science.context: This rapid pace exacerbates extreme weather events and sea-level rise, urging accelerated global mitigation strategies under frameworks like the Paris Agreement.

timeline.label: Paris Agreement adoption sets warming limits
Publication of updated warming rate analysis

key_terms.definition: Primary drivers of global warming, including CO2 and methane from human activities

science.headline: Genetically Modified Pig Liver Sustains Human Patient Until Transplant
science.description: A patient survived for weeks on a genetically engineered pig liver transplant, marking a milestone in xenotransplantation research.
science.context: This breakthrough addresses organ shortages by adapting animal organs for human use, potentially revolutionizing transplant medicine through genetic editing techniques.

timeline.label: First pig-to-human heart transplant trials begin
Successful pig liver sustainment case reported

key_terms.definition: Transplantation of organs or tissues between different species, here pig to human

science.headline: New HIV Strategy Activates Latent Virus to Trigger Immune Response
science.description: Researchers developed a method to expose hidden HIV reservoirs, forcing the virus to activate immune sensors for potential cure advancement.
science.context: Current antiretroviral therapies suppress but do not eradicate HIV; this approach targets latency, offering hope for functional cures in chronic infections.

timeline.label: HIV identified as global pandemic
Immune sensor activation technique published

key_terms.definition: Dormant viral sites in the body evading standard treatments

science.headline: NIH Refuses Union Recognition for Early-Career Researchers
science.description: The National Institutes of Health declared lab trainees as non-employees, denying unionization rights to early-career scientists.
science.context: This decision impacts labor protections for thousands in biomedical research, amid growing movements for better working conditions in US academia.

timeline.label: Union drives gain momentum in NIH labs
Official refusal to recognize union

key_terms.definition: US National Institutes of Health, primary federal biomedical research agency
